title: 8.1.6 Lab: Hollow It Out
description: Hollow out the box into an open-topped shell with the Hollow tool, with walls 3 mm thick. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Click the top face of the box
steps.instructions: You're starting from a 40 x 40 x 20 mm box. Click the flat top face of the box in the 3D view to select it.
hints: This is the same face you'd click to drill a hole — the middle of the flat top.

steps.title: Hollow it out
steps.instructions: Press the Hollow tool in the toolbar. The box becomes an open-topped shell, like a cup. In the Dimensions panel, wall reads 2 - type 3, so the walls are 3 mm thick.
hints: A message under the 3D view should read "Hollow 1 is open at the top face." That's the open top you want — you don't need any other tool for it.
Look for the field named "Hollow 1 wall" in the Dimensions panel. Click its number box, type 3, and press Enter.

requirements.title: An open-topped shell, 3 mm walls
requirements.description: The box is hollowed to 3 mm walls with the top face left open.
requirements.hint: Click the top face, then press Hollow. Type 3 in the wall field and check the message says the top is open.
